caseName: Associated Milk Producers, Inc. v. National Farmers' Organization, Inc.
caseNameFull: Associated Milk Producers, Inc. v. National Farmers' Organization, Inc. and Mid-America Dairymen, Inc. v. National Farmers' Organization, Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. 8th Cir. Motion of National Milk Producers Federation for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and these petitions.

Reported below: 687 F. 2d 1173.
